dogecoin.text: Elon Musk, a long-time Dogecoin supporter and Trump ally, was seen at Mar-a-Lago. Musk jokingly suggested leading a “Department of Government Efficiency” under Trump’s administration, tying his influence back to Dogecoin.

Dogecoin sits at sixth place among cryptocurrencies by market cap, trailing behind Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Binance Coin. Trump’s win has sparked expectations of deregulation, boosting the broader crypto market.

Dogecoin’s value has soared 157% since Donald Trump’s presidential win, pushing its market cap to $53 billion. The current price of the meme coin is 33% below its 2021 peak of $0.72 but marks its highest level since June 2021.

The strong reaction from Musk and law enforcement has fueled renewed interest in Dogecoin. The token is now trading at $0.27, gaining momentum amid the controversy.

Dogecoin surged over 5% after Elon Musk called out Reddit users threatening employees linked to $DOGE. Musk responded to posts exposing individuals making violent threats, stating that they had "broken the law."
